description: This source file defines the StateStore class responsible for managing persistent storage of jobs, assets, issues, and report summaries in a filesystem-based JSON format. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and modifying these entities, with atomic write operations to ensure data integrity. The file also includes utility functions for safe JSON reading and writing. It references models such as Job, Asset, Issue, and ReportSummary, as well as external storage helpers.

classes.name: StateStore
classes.description: A class providing filesystem JSON persistence for job-related data, including creating, reading, updating, and managing assets, issues, and summaries.
